sheets.name: Sheet1
values: The gap at the bottom sweep tile is visible.
Finishing of top & bottom of the sweep tile.
Finish the top of the sweep tile straight. Clean sweep tile.
Damaged / Excessive super glue visible / Popping joints
The installed LVT should be neatly installed without any visible defects.
Rectification on the wall / Visible corner profile / Align corner paint
Grout joints / Clean tiles & corner profiles
All tile joints must be uniform and clean.
Sockets & outlets must be neatly installed and finished.
Cracks are visible at the gypsum wall connection and the curtain wall profile.
Caulking of gypsum wall connection with curtain wall profiles
Partition glass joints are not neatly done.
Joint rectification at corners & between glass
The dirty element must be cleaned.
The floor joint profile does not have proper adhesion
Ensure that the floor joint profile is properly adhered and securely fixed in place.
Replace the damaged tiles and properly grout the tile joints.
Top cabinet doors are installed flush with the cabinet. The finishing of the countertop is not neat.
Customize upper cabinet doors for better usability, improve countertop finishes, and properly seal visible holes in custom furniture.
Holes are visible in custom furniture.
The frame of the MDF doors is damaged. MDF doors & frames have paint stains
Repair the damaged frames of the MDF doors and remove all paint stains from the doors and frames.
Identify and repair the AC leakage and ceiling leakage to prevent further damage.
Clean the decoration, varnish all cut sides, and complete the remaining installation properly.
Finish the installation of the decoration.
Paint differences are to be seen on the ceiling
Rectify visible paint differences on the ceiling to ensure a uniform finish.
Repair visible cracks and gaps at the ceiling to achieve a seamless finish.
Clean the ceiling to ensure a spotless and smooth surface
The door opens to the outside of the staircase. Also, a panic bar handle should be added to the door as described in drawing CN602 door D109.
Change the door direction to inside.
Apply resin protective paint as a topcoat.
No emergency lights installed in stairwell 2
The water-resistant layer is on top of the drains.
The water-resistant layer should be applied first, and then the dome of the drain
Steel structure doesn’t have fireproof paint
Apply fireproof paint for steel structures
Drains of the washbasin don’t comply
The overflow pipe should be positioned behind the louvers to ensure it remains concealed from street view.
Ducting of the roof is damaged.
Replace damaged ducting and unstable supports.
Supports of the ducting are unstable.
1 layer of waterproof paint to be applied
The roof cutouts of the leakages are not fixed.
Rectify the roof cutouts of the leakages accordingly
The air vents on the roof are positioned too close to each other, causing them to collide.
The bolts and washers of the louvers are starting to rust.

sheets.name: TI
values: Subject : Replacing generator of Centraal Lab
This form is intended to notify the contractor of moving the generator from Centraal Lab to another
location. The generator will be located behind the building B8-4. In the form you will find the detail of
the slab. Attached we also send the DWG file of the new location of the generator.
